question: Should the Control UI offer a per-click Markdown/plain-text copy menu, add a persisted default format, or remain Markdown-only, and what content semantics must the plain-text conversion preserve?
rationale: The missing capability is source-confirmed, but the interaction model and treatment of code blocks, links, lists, tables, and embedded content are product choices rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Add per-click format menu
options.body: Keep Markdown as the immediate default and expose plain text through a compact adjacent menu with documented conversion semantics.

options.title: Add persisted copy preference
options.body: Let users choose a default format, accepting additional preference storage, settings UI, and upgrade behavior for a small clipboard action.

options.title: Keep Markdown-only copying
options.body: Decline the additional UI and conversion complexity and leave users to paste through an external Markdown-to-text workflow.

recommendation.title: Add per-click format menu
recommendation.body: Keep Markdown as the immediate default and expose plain text through a compact adjacent menu with documented conversion semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle introduced the current copy behavior, maintains the adjacent Control UI path, and is the strongest available product-direction owner in repository history.
